text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What a strange place... Am I up in the
sky,
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Little Bird
text_block_list.text: Tweet, tweet, tweet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what beautiful blue feathers! You're
Sky Blue,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Little Bird
text_block_list.text: Chirrrp, chirp... Tweet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Look over here. Can
I help
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flap, flap...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I simply can't refuse the
invitation of your
fluttering wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Just a moment. I'm on my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A soft light envelops Yamanin Zephyr as
she
chases the small bird. And then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... The academy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooshhh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The light is dancing atop the floral wind.
It's the
season of countless blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Such warm rays of sunshine. If only I
could
remain here indefinitely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, the sea is so beautiful! Its deep
blue
stretches out so far, billowing up
and down as the
ocean breeze races
overhead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is the breath of life that blows in
summer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The trees, the birds, the insects... It's as
if all of
nature is breathing together with
the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Everything is red... It's as if the forest is
aflame.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Cirrocumulus clouds race high across the
sky. The
autumnal winds carry the
slightest scent of winter.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In decay and darkness, there is light. No
matter
how many times I see the fall
colors, this sight
never fails to capture
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A world of silver...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even my breath is white. A frosty flurry
brings one
glittery gust after another...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And this quiet... It's as if the whole world
is
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It seems I drifted off. I suppose
that was
all a dream, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...But, that said, my mind's eye did see it
all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That scenery was sublime. I'm very
grateful, little
Sky Blue.
